title: Compatible affine edges from a split structural direct image
statement: Let f:X→S be flat, quasi-compact and separated [def-pc-scheme]. Put K=Rf_*(O_X[0]) and E=H¹(K) [lem-weil-pbc-flat-curve-derived-structure-model]. Suppose E is finite locally free [def-sc-finite-locally-free-sheaf], the structural H⁰ unit is invertible, and locally on S the restriction of K is O_S[0]⊕E[-1]. Then there are simultaneous Γ(T,O_T)-linear equivalences H¹(X×_S T,(pr_X)^*O_X)≃Γ(T,g^*E) for every affine scheme T and every g:T→S. They commute with the canonical module-cohomology pullback and the section-normalized tensor-pullback restriction of E [lem-weil-pbc-coherent-affine-base-change-edge-naturality]. All derived categories use the fixed recorded derived-category choices.

proof.text: The structural H⁰ unit gives O_S≅H⁰(K), hence H⁰(K) is finite locally free. Transport the local splitting from modules on the localized open site to modules on the open subscheme through the exact equivalence. Exact functors commute with single objects, finite biproducts and shifts; a degree-zero single shifted by -1 is a degree-one single.

The unit module is invertible and intrinsically flat. Its canonical derived tensor counit on a single complex is invertible. Flat invertible canonical base change makes the base-change mate invertible, so their pinned composite is invertible.
Apply coherent affine base-change edge naturality to the unit module. Retain its simultaneous linear comparisons and their restriction equation.

theorem exists_curve_coherentEdge {X S : Scheme.{u}} (f : X ⟶ S)
    [QuasiCompact f] [IsSeparated f] [Flat f]
    [hDU : ∀ U : S.Opens, HasDerivedCategory.{w}
      (SheafOfModules.{u} ((moduleRings S.toRingedSpace).over U))]
    [SheafOfModules.IsFiniteLocallyFree (derivedStructureH1.{u, w} f)]
    (hzero : IsIso ((DerivedCategory.homologyFunctor.{w, u, u + 1}
      (SheafOfModules.{u} (moduleRings S.toRingedSpace)) 0).map
      (derivedStructureUnit.{u, w} f)))
    (hsplit : ∀ s : S, ∃ U : S.Opens, s ∈ U ∧
      Nonempty ((@Functor.mapDerivedCategory.{w, w, u, u, u + 1, u + 1}
        (SheafOfModules.{u} (moduleRings S.toRingedSpace))
        SheafOfModules.instCategory (curveEdge_schemeAbelian S) (hD S)
        (SheafOfModules.{u} ((moduleRings S.toRingedSpace).over U))
        SheafOfModules.instCategory (curveEdge_overAbelian S U) (hDU U)
        (SheafOfModules.overFunctor.{u} (moduleRings S.toRingedSpace) U)
        (curveEdge_overAdditive S U) (curveEdge_overLimits S U) (curveEdge_overColimits S U)).obj
          (derivedStructureImage.{u, w} f) ≅
        (DerivedCategory.singleFunctor.{w, u, u + 1}
          (SheafOfModules.{u} ((moduleRings S.toRingedSpace).over U)) 0).obj
            (SheafOfModules.unit ((moduleRings S.toRingedSpace).over U)) ⊞
        ((DerivedCategory.singleFunctor.{w, u, u + 1}
          (SheafOfModules.{u} ((moduleRings S.toRingedSpace).over U)) 0).obj
            ((derivedStructureH1.{u, w} f).over U))⟦(-1 : ℤ)⟧)) :
    ∃ e : ∀ (T : Scheme.{u}) (g : T ⟶ S) (_ : IsAffine T),
        coherentEdgeH.{u} f (SheafOfModules.unit X.ringCatSheaf) g ≃ₗ[Γ(T, ⊤)]
          (RingedSpace.globalSectionsFunctor T.toRingedSpace).obj
            ((tensorPullback g).obj
              (coherentEdgeCohomology.{u, w} f (SheafOfModules.unit X.ringCatSheaf) 1)),
      ∀ (T T' : Scheme.{u}) (g : T ⟶ S) (h : T' ⟶ T)
        (hT : IsAffine T) (hT' : IsAffine T')
        (x : coherentEdgeH.{u} f (SheafOfModules.unit X.ringCatSheaf) g),
        e T' (h ≫ g) hT' (coherentEdgePullback.{u} f
          (SheafOfModules.unit X.ringCatSheaf) g h x) =
          coherentEdgeRho.{u} g h
            (coherentEdgeCohomology.{u, w} f (SheafOfModules.unit X.ringCatSheaf) 1)
              (e T g hT x)
